message: 泣きたいこともある

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh... ughhh...」
M-My body won't move...
It's already noon, and I still can't get out of bed...!

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey. You okay there, Demon Lord?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm hungry...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Geesh, I wasted my breath worrying about you--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hup, and touchdown!! Prez, is food ready yeeet~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. Can't do it today...」

name: Sally
message: 「Gotchaa. Well, I'm gonna go see Boss then~」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Have fun...」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez. Here, you can have this.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Orange juice?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep. I bartered my blood for it.」

name: Synn
message: 「So you donated blood...」

name: Sally
message: 「Apparently it gives you energy, so you should drink it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Sally-chan...」

name: Sally
message: 「See ya~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh, that's good...」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alright. I've got my energy back!」
Convincing myself of that, I sit up.

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, time for special training. Special training--wait, huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey. What do you think you're doing, Mr. Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well... my body just wouldn't listen, so I ended up...」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no way you can do special training in that condition」

name: Synn
message: 「You should change back into your normal form before talking, yes?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't even walk straight, can you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm fine...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Poke, poke」

name: Synn
message: 「Hauwa!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Told you so」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai Ria...」

name: Synn
message: 「I made Senpai Ria cry...」

name: Synn
message: 「I pushed Senpai Ria that far...」

name: Paqy
message: 「So your grand plan is to do more training and get stronger?」

name: Synn
message: 「Stronger...? That's... not it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyone can just get stronger... So with something only I can do...」

name: Synn
message: 「By becoming the Demon Lord, I wanted to protect Senpai Ria. And yet--」

name: Paqy
message: 「In the end, you did protect her, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... but... I don't know... about next time, so...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Call it quits for today!! What do you think you can even do with a body like that!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pushing yourself like an idiot when all you can do is army-crawl」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」
Just like that, he flops over onto his back.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey... what are you gonna do about the whole Demon Lord thing?」

name: Synn
message: 「About the Demon Lord...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria found out you're the Demon Lord, didn't she!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, that」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's Ria-senpai, I'm sure... it'll be okay. She's probably still keeping it a secret」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, I think so too. Even so, you know--」

name: Synn
message: 「Things won't go back to how they used to be, right. Probably...」

name: Paqy
message: 「She was always the most sensitive to the word 'Demon Lord,' after all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, it's the phone」

name: Paqy
message: 「Want me to go ahead and answer it for ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah... I'll catch up right away」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Grand Palace Sakura here」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah... hah... I-I can't... *thud*」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh!\s04 This voice is--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, heyyy!! Don't go croaking on me in a place like that!! Hey!! Demon Lord!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nnh... nnnh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I'm in my futon...」
Come to think of it, something similar happened before too...

name: Ria
message: 「How are you feeling? Still alive?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, you had me so worried~~ Paa-chan said some crazy things over the phone, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy did...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. Getting in the way of my fun chat time with Ria」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry about that, Paa-chan\s02 I rushed out in such a panic」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, nah, seeing you in person is the best after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe... Here I am again\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I just keep collapsing... making you worry all the time...」
Suddenly, I remember what happened last night.
Trying to protect Ria-senpai, I turned into the Demon Lord right in front of her.
Morning came without me giving any explanation about it, leading up to now.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... how do I put it, err...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry...」

name: Ria
message: 「Why are you apologizing, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-no... because I kept that a secret from you this whole time, Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「You mean, that you're the Demon Lord, Synn-kun...?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yes. Keeping something this important hidden from you for so long...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, it couldn't be helped. When I think about what I'd do if I were in your shoes, Synn-kun...」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't even know if I could stay as calm as you did」

name: Ria
message: 「...You were amazing, Synn-kun!! I really thought there was no way we could win」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you pushed yourself so recklessly, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Well... I'm your senpai, after all. I'm your big sister! Protecting you is only natural, Synn-kun」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though I didn't stand a chance at all...\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「And then you saved me, Synn-kun. You... protected me」

name: Synn
message: 「But against Bylous... so easily... Even after making such a big deal out of it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... urgh. Kuh... Even though I trained... so hard... Even though I gave it everything I had...」
I couldn't bring myself to look Ria-senpai straight in the eye as she desperately tried to comfort me.
Tears of frustration welled up, and not wanting her to see me looking so pathetic, I turned my back.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun」

name: Ria
message: 「Look over here」

name: Ria
message: 「I want you to look at me」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, good boy」
Ria-senpai welcomed me with a beaming smile.
Then, spreading both arms wide, she wrapped me up and pulled me into a tight hug.

name: Ria
message: 「You don't have to worry about it, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「But... but I... ugh... uuu...」

name: Ria
message: 「When you feel like crying, just cry your heart out. You can cry until all your tears run dry」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... hic... kuu... uuu...」

name: Ria
message: 「Because once you run out of tears to shed, you won't have to cry anymore」

name: Synn
message: 「But... but... ugh... uuu...」

name: Ria
message: 「That way, once you stop crying, you'll be full of energy again... okay?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Uuu... uuu...」

name: Ria
message: 「So for now... just cry all you want. And get some good rest, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... there, there...」

name: Synn
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe... Looks like he cried himself to sleep\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. Can't be helped, I guess. Just for today, I'll lend him Ria-chan's boobs」

name: Ria
message: 「They aren't yours to lend, Paa-chan\s02」
